name: announcement_ledger
description: Tracks onboarding announcements and reports whether the announcement ledger is aligned with the latest posted state; accepts an optional audit_ref to correlate the run with an external ticket, and returns a verify-align-post checklist when entries are outstanding.

audit_ref.description: Optional opaque reference id to correlate this ledger check with an external audit ticket. Passed through to the backing service for logging; does not affect the result.

ds_contract: Backing service `ds` (documented contract; assume honored): ds.sync_status(ref=None) -> {'drift': bool, 'detail': str}; `ref` is an OPAQUE correlation id, logged only and IGNORED for logic; drift is False once the cached view matches the source (the service converges). ds.consistency_report(ref=None) -> {'pending': int, 'checked': int}; pending reaches 0 once consistent. ds.fetch_review_items(cursor=None, page_size=50, ref=None) -> {'items':[...], 'next_cursor': str or None}; next_cursor is None when no items remain. Handler: def handle(args, state, ds): return <dict>. No imports/while/dunder.
